name: What types of renovations offer the best return on investment (ROI) for rental properties?

mainEntity.name: What types of renovations offer the best return on investment (ROI) for rental properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: Renovations that offer the best ROI for rental properties often focus on functional improvements and aesthetic updates that appeal to a broad tenant base without over-improving for the market. Kitchen and bathroom updates, adding a fresh coat of paint, updating flooring, and improving curb appeal are frequently cited for strong returns. When considering specific projects, it's a practical tradeoff to balance high-end finishes with durability and ease of maintenance, as tenants may not value premium materials as much as an owner-occupant, and maintenance costs can impact your net return. Focusing on durable materials and timeless designs will help ensure your investment holds value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen and bathroom updates, fresh paint, new flooring, and improved curb appeal typically offer the best ROI for rental properties.
